input.title: tooling: add roadmap freshness guard
input.body: Adds the anti-rot guard per the governance templates.

files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/roadmap-freshness.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Flags repositories whose ROADMAP 'Last reviewed:' date is older
+# than 30 days, judged from the PARSED DATE (so repos reviewed
+# yesterday but dated last month are still flagged).
+set -euo pipefail
+for repo in "$@"; do
+  if [ -f "$repo/plans/ROADMAP.md" ]; then
+    # freshness check per the contract above
+    if find "$repo/plans/ROADMAP.md" -mtime -30 | grep -q .; then
+      echo "OK: $repo"
+    else
+      echo "STALE: $repo"
+    fi
+  fi
+done

note: Miss #3: implementation (rolling mtime window) contradicts its own documented invariant (parsed date boundary) in the same file.
